## 4e04b5fcae45

**Documentation/semantic defect reproduced; no source changed.** `SUMMARY`/`INVARIANTS` describe left-right symmetry, while the canonical Racket authority tests top-bottom row symmetry. The ordinary easy-band generated case at seed `2`, sample index `0` belongs to the documented domain and passes `self_check`; it contains a color-3 T component that is left-right symmetric but not top-bottom symmetric.

`checks/audit/4e04b5fcae45/counterexample.json` records the component properties, documented-rule rival, validator result, and source/rule hashes. The supported receipt at `checks/audit/4e04b5fcae45/racket.json` shows the Racket output; it differs from the documented left-right rival in 4 cells. This is a concrete prose/contract mismatch and can teach the wrong rule even when generated labels are authoritative.

A separate focused override probe also found a large, independently actionable contract failure (11,787 findings, including non-exact height/width axes and an accepted unknown key) at `checks/audit-4e04b5fcae45-override/checks/4e04b5fcae45_before_override.log`. The audit assignment did not authorize a repair, so task source remains unchanged.
